website.style_intent: Support Brain Design with domain-fit website art direction and section depth.
website.layout_behavior: Full website rhythm with varied sections, proof, conversion, and source-template editability.
website.visual_depth: Section depth, surface hierarchy, image treatment, and CTA emphasis.
website.best_for: Full website templates and marketplace-ready website systems.
website.accessibility_notes: Use accessible contrast, focus states, keyboard paths, and responsive layout checks.

landing.style_intent: Create a niche-aware conversion page with enough proof, offer clarity, and objection handling.
landing.layout_behavior: Focused landing flow with offer, context, proof, details, and conversion closure.
landing.visual_depth: CTA emphasis, proof block emphasis, surface hierarchy, and image/offer treatment.
landing.best_for: Landing pages that preserve niche logic without collapsing into a tiny generic funnel.
landing.accessibility_notes: Use readable sections, clear CTA contrast, accessible forms, and reduced motion when animation exists.

presentation.style_intent: Translate the brief into slide hierarchy, master consistency, and data/storytelling clarity.
presentation.layout_behavior: Slide-by-slide composition with cover, sections, data, comparison, proof, and closing.
presentation.visual_depth: Shape framing, image framing, contrast, data emphasis, and slide-to-slide rhythm.
presentation.best_for: PPTX, PowerPoint, Google Slides, Keynote, proposal decks, and pitch decks.
presentation.accessibility_notes: Check projector contrast, title/body hierarchy, readable data labels, and safe margins.

web_deck.style_intent: Translate the brief into a fixed browser stage with runtime navigation and slide motion that carries the argument.
web_deck.layout_behavior: Fixed 1920x1080 stage composed slide by slide, with cover, sections, data, proof, and closing authored at stage size and never reflowed.
web_deck.visual_depth: Stage scale discipline, entrance and reveal timing, slide transition motion, and surface/data emphasis.
web_deck.best_for: Browser-rendered decks, animated presentations, single-file presenter decks, webinar/demo-day decks, and deck-to-web conversion.
web_deck.accessibility_notes: Check reduced-motion fallback, keyboard navigation, inert inactive slides, projection contrast, and readable type at stage scale.

email.style_intent: Build an email-safe hierarchy that works across clients and mobile stacking.
email.layout_behavior: Header, hero message, modular content blocks, CTA, secondary links, legal footer.
email.visual_depth: Email-safe hierarchy, image weight control, alt text, and button contrast.
email.best_for: Email newsletters, product promos, announcements, and editorial digests.
email.accessibility_notes: Use alt text, fallback fonts, clear unsubscribe/legal footer, and client-compatible layout.

brand_kit.style_intent: Define identity rules, visual motif, typography, color usage, and brand applications.
brand_kit.layout_behavior: Identity system blocks with usage rules, collateral examples, and do/don't guidance.
brand_kit.visual_depth: Logo clearspace, motif behavior, color-role system, and application consistency.
brand_kit.best_for: Logo design, brand identity, visual identity, brand kits, and collateral direction.
brand_kit.accessibility_notes: Check minimum logo size, one-color usage, contrast, and legibility across applications.

menu_design.style_intent: Organize food/menu content for category scanning, price clarity, and print/digital readability.
menu_design.layout_behavior: Category-based menu structure with item hierarchy, price styling, and readability rules.
menu_design.visual_depth: Category spacing, item hierarchy, badge clarity, and print-safe contrast.
menu_design.best_for: Restaurant menus, cafe menus, food menu posters, and print/digital hospitality menus.
menu_design.accessibility_notes: Check type size, contrast, safe margins, price alignment, and dietary/badge clarity.

social_post.style_intent: Prioritize hook readability, crop-safe composition, carousel rhythm, and export quality.
social_post.layout_behavior: Hook-first social composition with format-specific hierarchy and CTA/save/share cue.
social_post.visual_depth: Thumbnail readability, safe crop zones, brand consistency, and post-to-post rhythm.
social_post.best_for: Instagram posts, social campaigns, carousel posts, story design, and feed systems.
social_post.accessibility_notes: Check small-size readability, contrast, safe crop, and export resolution.

static_canvas.style_intent: Compose a static visual with clear focal point, safe margins, and export-ready readability.
static_canvas.layout_behavior: Static canvas hierarchy with headline, visual focal point, body, CTA, and export notes.
static_canvas.visual_depth: Focal point, background treatment, safe margins, print/export clarity.
static_canvas.best_for: Posters, flyers, banners, thumbnails, covers, and static campaign assets.
static_canvas.accessibility_notes: Check print contrast, legibility, safe margins, and export resolution.

ui_kit.style_intent: Document reusable interface components, tokens, variants, and accessibility states.
ui_kit.layout_behavior: Component inventory with state matrix, variant rules, naming, and source hygiene notes.
ui_kit.visual_depth: Token mapping, state contrast, variant clarity, and component anatomy.
ui_kit.best_for: UI kits, interface kits, dashboard UI kits, and source component sets.
ui_kit.accessibility_notes: Cover default, hover, focus, disabled, error, loading, keyboard, and contrast states.

component_library.style_intent: Define reusable components with variants, states, token mapping, and usage rules.
component_library.layout_behavior: Library anatomy with component categories, variants, states, and usage examples.
component_library.visual_depth: Variant behavior, state coverage, and accessibility affordance clarity.
component_library.best_for: Component libraries, component sets, Figma components, and reusable UI systems.
component_library.accessibility_notes: Map interaction, focus, disabled, loading, error, and responsive states.

design_system.style_intent: Create source-of-truth tokens, component rules, states, accessibility, and handoff guidance.
design_system.layout_behavior: Token foundations plus component inventory, state coverage, variants, and governance rules.
design_system.visual_depth: Semantic tokens, component anatomy, state hierarchy, and source hygiene.
design_system.best_for: Design systems, token systems, component systems, and style guides.
design_system.accessibility_notes: Define contrast, focus, keyboard, state, naming, and usage standards.

dashboard.style_intent: Support data density, KPI hierarchy, filters, states, and role-aware operational views.
dashboard.layout_behavior: Dashboard modules with navigation, KPI cards, charts, tables, filters, activity, and states.
dashboard.visual_depth: Data emphasis, status color, table hierarchy, and filter affordance.
dashboard.best_for: Dashboards, admin panels, analytics, POS, CRM, and operational systems.
dashboard.accessibility_notes: Check chart labels, table navigation, status color redundancy, and responsive density.

mobile_app.style_intent: Define mobile screens, navigation, state coverage, and touch-first task flows.
mobile_app.layout_behavior: Mobile screen set with onboarding/auth when relevant, task flow, states, and nav pattern.
mobile_app.visual_depth: Screen hierarchy, touch affordance, state clarity, and microinteraction notes.
mobile_app.best_for: Mobile app screens, onboarding screens, iOS/Android flows, and app UI systems.
mobile_app.accessibility_notes: Check touch target size, text scale, contrast, reduced motion, and screen-reader labels.

brochure_design.style_intent: Organize service, brand, and contact information into a print/PDF brochure flow.
brochure_design.layout_behavior: Cover, interior information flow, benefit blocks, imagery, trust/contact, and back-cover closure.
brochure_design.visual_depth: Fold/page rhythm, image-text balance, contact emphasis, and print-safe contrast.
brochure_design.best_for: Company brochures, service brochures, finance brochures, restaurant brochures, and PDF collateral.
brochure_design.accessibility_notes: Check print contrast, readable type size, fold-safe margins, and PDF export clarity.

print_collateral.style_intent: Build a clear static promotional layout with safe margins, hierarchy, and export discipline.
print_collateral.layout_behavior: Static promotional canvas with headline, supporting copy, focal visual, contact/CTA if appropriate, and export specs.
print_collateral.visual_depth: Readable hierarchy, focal contrast, crop/safe margin awareness, and print/export clarity.
print_collateral.best_for: Flyers, leaflets, pamphlets, signage, print designs, and promotional collateral.
print_collateral.accessibility_notes: Check contrast, minimum type size, safe margins, and exported resolution.

poster_design.style_intent: Create strong visual attention with readable message hierarchy and print/export clarity.
poster_design.layout_behavior: Poster composition with focal visual, headline hierarchy, supporting details, and print-safe margins.
poster_design.visual_depth: Focal emphasis, contrast, large-format readability, and export discipline.
poster_design.best_for: Restaurant posters, event posters, promo posters, and food posters.
poster_design.accessibility_notes: Check text legibility at viewing distance, contrast, safe margins, and export size.

banner_design.style_intent: Create crop-safe headline and visual focus across banner/ad/social banner formats.
banner_design.layout_behavior: Wide or platform-specific banner with concise headline, visual focus, supporting cue, and export variants.
banner_design.visual_depth: Crop-safe composition, strong headline contrast, visual focus, and export size coverage.
banner_design.best_for: Restaurant banners, ad banners, web banners, hero banners, display banners, and social banners.
banner_design.accessibility_notes: Check small-height readability, crop safety, contrast, and platform export specs.

thumbnail_design.style_intent: Make a small-size hook readable with strong focal contrast and crop-safe composition.
thumbnail_design.layout_behavior: Thumbnail composition with hook text, focal subject, high contrast, and platform-safe crop.
thumbnail_design.visual_depth: Immediate focal subject, legible hook, edge-safe crop, and small-size readability.
thumbnail_design.best_for: Video thumbnails, cover thumbnails, YouTube thumbnails, and restaurant thumbnails.
thumbnail_design.accessibility_notes: Check readability at small size, high contrast, crop safety, and export dimensions.

invoice_template.style_intent: Make billing metadata, item tables, totals, and payment instructions easy to scan.
invoice_template.layout_behavior: Document layout with sender/client info, invoice metadata, item table, totals, payment, and legal notes.
invoice_template.visual_depth: Table clarity, totals emphasis, document hierarchy, and PDF/print reliability.
invoice_template.best_for: Invoice templates, billing templates, payment invoices, and printable finance documents.
invoice_template.accessibility_notes: Check table readability, numeric alignment, print contrast, and PDF output clarity.

resume_template.style_intent: Make profile, experience, education, and skills readable, credible, and ATS/PDF friendly.
resume_template.layout_behavior: Document layout with profile header, summary, experience, education, skills, portfolio/contact, and export notes.
resume_template.visual_depth: Information hierarchy, spacing density, section clarity, and PDF/print polish.
resume_template.best_for: Resume templates, CV templates, curriculum vitae, and portfolio resume documents.
resume_template.accessibility_notes: Check ATS readability, type size, spacing density, print contrast, and PDF export.

ticket_receipt_design.style_intent: Make order details, quantities, modifiers, totals, and receipt metadata fast to scan.
ticket_receipt_design.layout_behavior: Narrow document or ticket layout with order metadata, item rows, notes/modifiers, total, payment, and optional QR/barcode.
ticket_receipt_design.visual_depth: Receipt width discipline, row hierarchy, total emphasis, and thermal/print readability.
ticket_receipt_design.best_for: Restaurant order tickets, kitchen tickets, receipts, nota, struk, and bill templates.
ticket_receipt_design.accessibility_notes: Check item scanning, receipt width, modifier notes, totals clarity, and thermal print contrast.

letterhead_design.style_intent: Create a printable document identity with logo placement, contact hierarchy, footer/legal info, and brand consistency.
letterhead_design.layout_behavior: Document header/footer system with clear logo zone, contact details, footer/legal company information, safe margins, and PDF export notes.
letterhead_design.visual_depth: Brand consistency, typographic restraint, margin discipline, and document hierarchy.
letterhead_design.best_for: Company letterheads, finance letterheads, business stationery, and printable brand documents.
letterhead_design.accessibility_notes: Check readable contact information, print contrast, PDF margins, and consistent brand usage.

price_list_design.style_intent: Organize items, services, and prices for fast comparison across print and digital formats.
price_list_design.layout_behavior: Category-based list with item/service hierarchy, aligned prices, currency/discount notes, optional badges, and export notes.
price_list_design.visual_depth: Table/list clarity, price alignment, category spacing, and readable print/digital hierarchy.
price_list_design.best_for: Restaurant price lists, service price lists, menu price lists, and printable pricing sheets.
price_list_design.accessibility_notes: Check price alignment, type size, contrast, currency clarity, and print/digital readability.

table_tent_design.style_intent: Build a tabletop menu or promo card with panel/fold logic and distance-readable hierarchy.
table_tent_design.layout_behavior: Front/back or multi-panel tent card with headline/menu offer, featured items, QR/menu code, price or promo info, fold/dieline notes, and safe margins.
table_tent_design.visual_depth: Panel contrast, table-distance readability, fold-safe composition, and print/dieline clarity.
table_tent_design.best_for: Restaurant table tents, tent cards, tabletop menus, table display menus, and promo table cards.
table_tent_design.accessibility_notes: Check table-distance type size, QR clarity, fold safety, contrast, and print readability.

catalog_design.style_intent: Create a print/PDF catalog browsing flow for product categories, product grids, details, and SKU/price clarity.
catalog_design.layout_behavior: Cover/intro, category structure, product grid/list, detail snippets, price/SKU fields, image treatment, page/spread rhythm, and export notes.
catalog_design.visual_depth: Browsing hierarchy, product image rhythm, spread pacing, SKU/price clarity, and print/PDF polish.
catalog_design.best_for: Product catalogs, fashion catalogs, catalogue templates, product catalog PDFs, and print sales collateral.
catalog_design.accessibility_notes: Check product label readability, image-to-text balance, print contrast, page numbering, and PDF export clarity.

lookbook_design.style_intent: Create an editorial collection flow for mood, styling, product story, and image spread rhythm.
lookbook_design.layout_behavior: Cover/editorial opener, collection story, outfit/product image spreads, style notes, product references, mood rhythm, and print/PDF export notes.
lookbook_design.visual_depth: Editorial pacing, image-led hierarchy, collection mood, spread contrast, and visual rhythm.
lookbook_design.best_for: Fashion lookbooks, collection lookbooks, editorial lookbooks, seasonal lookbooks, and style guide lookbooks.
lookbook_design.accessibility_notes: Check caption readability, image crop consistency, print contrast, page rhythm, and PDF export clarity.

cover_design.style_intent: Compose a focal cover with readable title hierarchy, safe crop zones, and export-ready contrast.
cover_design.layout_behavior: Format-aware cover layout with title, focal visual, subtitle/author or brand metadata, safe area, and export notes.
cover_design.visual_depth: Focal hierarchy, title contrast, crop-safe composition, and format-specific readability.
cover_design.best_for: Facebook covers, book covers, ebook covers, magazine covers, report covers, social covers, and cover banners.
cover_design.accessibility_notes: Check title contrast, crop safety, small preview readability, and export dimensions.

voucher_coupon_design.style_intent: Make offer value, code/QR, terms, expiry, and redemption instructions clear in a print/digital card.
voucher_coupon_design.layout_behavior: Card/voucher layout with offer hierarchy, brand area, code or QR zone, expiry/terms, redemption instruction, safe margins, and export notes.
voucher_coupon_design.visual_depth: Offer emphasis, code clarity, terms hierarchy, and print/digital polish.
voucher_coupon_design.best_for: Gift vouchers, coupons, restaurant vouchers, gift cards, loyalty cards, membership cards, and reward cards.
voucher_coupon_design.accessibility_notes: Check code readability, expiry/terms size, QR contrast, safe margins, and print/digital output.

sticker_design.style_intent: Make compact marks or messages readable with die-cut, material, and print safety in mind.
sticker_design.layout_behavior: Compact sticker layout with shape, focal graphic/mark, text hierarchy, die-cut safety, material/finish notes, and export specs.
sticker_design.visual_depth: Recognition-first contrast, shape clarity, edge safety, and print finish awareness.
sticker_design.best_for: Restaurant stickers, brand stickers, packaging stickers, label stickers, and compact print marks.
sticker_design.accessibility_notes: Check tiny-size readability, die-cut margin, contrast, and print finish constraints.

postcard_design.style_intent: Create front/back static card communication with clear image, message, address/contact, and safe margins.
postcard_design.layout_behavior: Front/back postcard layout with visual side, message hierarchy, address/contact area when relevant, safe margins, and print/export notes.
postcard_design.visual_depth: Front/back contrast, message clarity, image hierarchy, and print-ready spacing.
postcard_design.best_for: Postcards, greeting cards, invitation cards, promo postcards, and restaurant postcards.
postcard_design.accessibility_notes: Check message readability, address space, contrast, safe margins, and print export.

certificate_design.style_intent: Make recipient, title, issuer, date, signature, and seal hierarchy clear and printable.
certificate_design.layout_behavior: Certificate layout with heading, recipient/name field, issuer/signature/seal, date/serial field, border/ornament, and PDF/print export.
certificate_design.visual_depth: Formal hierarchy, border/ornament framing, signature/seal emphasis, and print clarity.
certificate_design.best_for: Certificate templates, awards, diplomas, sertifikat, and printable recognition documents.
certificate_design.accessibility_notes: Check name-field readability, print contrast, signature/seal clarity, and PDF export.

booklet_design.style_intent: Guide readers through multi-page print/PDF content with cover, spread rhythm, section pages, and back-cover closure.
booklet_design.layout_behavior: Booklet system with cover, contents/intro, page/spread rhythm, section pages, image/text balance, contact/back page, and export notes.
booklet_design.visual_depth: Page rhythm, spread pacing, section hierarchy, image/text balance, and print/PDF polish.
booklet_design.best_for: Booklets, mini brochures, guide booklets, finance booklets, product booklets, and booklet templates.
booklet_design.accessibility_notes: Check page numbering, reading order, print contrast, type size, and PDF export.

packaging_label_design.style_intent: Clarify product identity, variant, required info, barcode/QR, material, finish, and print/dieline constraints.
packaging_label_design.layout_behavior: Packaging label layout with product name, variant/flavor/size, info area, barcode/QR or regulatory area, material/finish, and dieline/export notes.
packaging_label_design.visual_depth: Shelf-readable product hierarchy, compact info clarity, dieline safety, and material-aware finish.
packaging_label_design.best_for: Coffee packaging labels, product labels, bottle labels, jar labels, pouch labels, and box labels.
packaging_label_design.accessibility_notes: Check small product text, barcode quiet zone, contrast, dieline safety, and print finish.

label_design.style_intent: Create a compact label with clear brand/product hierarchy, supporting info, material/finish, and export notes.
label_design.layout_behavior: Label layout with shape/size, brand/product hierarchy, supporting info, material/finish, and print/export notes.
label_design.visual_depth: Compact hierarchy, label shape clarity, material-aware treatment, and print/export discipline.
label_design.best_for: Coffee labels, product labels, brand labels, sticker labels, and general label design.
label_design.accessibility_notes: Check small-size readability, edge safety, contrast, material finish, and export specs.

price_tag_design.style_intent: Make price, product/variant info, SKU/barcode, and die-cut/print requirements readable in a compact retail tag.
price_tag_design.layout_behavior: Compact tag layout with price hierarchy, product/variant info, SKU/barcode, material/finish, hole/string or die-cut note, and export notes.
price_tag_design.visual_depth: Retail scan clarity, price emphasis, barcode quiet zone, tag edge safety, and print finish awareness.
price_tag_design.best_for: Fashion price tags, retail price tags, product price tags, and tag harga designs.
price_tag_design.accessibility_notes: Check price readability, SKU/barcode clarity, die-cut margin, contrast, and print export.

hang_tag_design.style_intent: Make brand, product details, size/material, price/SKU, and hole/string placement clear for retail print finishing.
hang_tag_design.layout_behavior: Front/back hang tag with brand/logo area, product/size/material info, price/SKU/barcode, hole/string placement, and print/export notes.
hang_tag_design.visual_depth: Brand recognition, compact retail information hierarchy, hole/string safety, and print finish clarity.
hang_tag_design.best_for: Fashion hang tags, clothing hang tags, apparel tags, swing tags, and retail hang tags.
hang_tag_design.accessibility_notes: Check compact type, hole placement safety, barcode clarity, contrast, and print/export specs.
